scope: Local source and real-Chromium reproduction only. No hosted, SSH, provider, credential, Root or business-write activity.

hosted_acceptance.note: Original Root 43215810588 / a7ff971 / 352cb886 FE gate reported Fetch.continueRequest Invalid InterceptionId; hosted causation is not proven here. Candidate is not claimed accepted; redeploy and QA remain with the original STRAT Human/Ops owner.

local_root_cause: Chromium can deliver Fetch.requestPaused before Network.requestWillBeSent for the same network id (observed locally for XHR /held, e.g. network id 7152.2, in the full-suite run). The helper looked up the network entry only at pause time, found none, and therefore had no lifecycle binding or pre-command sample; a later real navigation-cancelled Invalid InterceptionId could not be proven and was recorded as a transport failure. Historical hosted ordering is unmeasured (unknown).
fix: On requestPaused without a network entry, register an unbound placeholder under the network id; the later requestWillBeSent binds frame/loader onto that same object. Proof rules are unchanged (same-id cancellation timestamped no later than the pre-command Performance sample plus document replacement, same-document navigation or detach). An unbound request never gains proof and still fails closed. No global swallow, no assertHealthy removal, no timeout/SLA change.

reproduction.command: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=<chromium 1223 cache> PANTHEON_FE_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1 npx playwright test e2e/hosted-bff-streaming-transport.spec.ts
reproduction.before_fix: Full suite intermittently failed 2 of 6 runs (queued-positive, same-document and exact-82ff tests) with Pinned BFF transport failures: Fetch.continueRequest Invalid InterceptionId; instrumented runs showed the failing requests had no network entry at pause time. New deterministic regression (real Chromium, real event delivery deferred in order, nothing synthesized) fails on the pre-fix helper (exit non-zero, timed out).
reproduction.after_fix: Full spec exit 0; 5 consecutive repeats of the 18 non-aa17 tests exit 0; new positive and live-invalid-id negative regressions pass; all PR989 positive/negative regressions retained.

trace_policy: No tokens, auth headers, URLs with data or business content recorded.

frame_detach_addendum.root_cause: For a real iframe removal Chromium emits Network.loadingFailed(canceled) BEFORE Page.frameDetached for the same network id. The helper's frameDetached handler required !request.failed, and requestfailed treated the detached-frame ERR_ABORTED as live, so detach proof was discarded.
frame_detach_addendum.fix: frameDetached now marks detached for same-frame interceptions that have not yet had their pre-command Performance sample (request.sampled) and are not closed; a detach observed after the sample/command cannot excuse a live failure. requestfailed also accepts ERR_ABORTED when the request's frame is detached (checked after the existing 25ms delay). Same-id canceledAt<=pre-command sample rule unchanged; no blanket suppression.
frame_detach_addendum.heldSample_scope: Test harness clears heldSample when the held continuation begins so a later navigation sample is not held.
new_tests: iframe removal cancelling a held interception settles healthy (x3, positive)
live abort then later iframe removal stays actionable (negative: Invalid InterceptionId and ERR_ABORTED retained)
